source.description: Project parser/load point where libvips copies attacker-controlled HEIF metadata bytes into the metadata buffer.
source.note: Libvips parse/load point: the fuzz target only supplies an image buffer, while this project function reads and parses attacker-controlled HEIF metadata into data/length.
source.value_from: Project parser/load point where libvips copies attacker-controlled HEIF metadata bytes into the metadata buffer.; value `data / length`; from `error = heif_image_handle_get_metadata(`

tainted_value_origin.description: First vulnerability-relevant parsed metadata: HEIF metadata type, data pointer, and length derived from attacker-controlled file contents.
tainted_value_origin.note: For EXIF metadata the vulnerable code skips four bytes and subtracts from length without checking length > 4 in this version.

sink.description: ASan-visible OOB read occurs in memcmp while libexif checks for the six-byte EXIF header using an inconsistent/oversized length.

root_cause.description: Root cause: the EXIF loader accepts an unbounded attacker-controlled metadata length as int and has no size guard before passing it to libexif. The patch changes the length type to size_t and adds a maximum-size rejection before exif_data_load_data.

coarse_trace.summary: Accepts attacker-controlled image bytes as a libvips blob.
Extracts HEIF metadata, identifies EXIF metadata, adjusts pointer/length, and attaches it as VIPS_META_EXIF_NAME.
Retrieves the EXIF blob and calls the EXIF parser.
Forwards unchecked EXIF metadata length to libexif.
Reads six bytes with memcmp while checking the EXIF header, triggering ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ.

fine_trace.note: Libvips parse/load point: loads attacker-controlled HEIF metadata bytes into the allocated metadata buffer.
Attacker-controlled metadata type selects the EXIF path.
Skips the HEIF EXIF offset prefix. The patch later adds a length > 4 check before doing this.
Produces the EXIF payload length passed onward to image metadata.
Stores the attacker-controlled EXIF data pointer and length as image metadata.
Retrieves the EXIF blob and passes data/size to the EXIF loader.
The vulnerable function accepts unbounded EXIF length without the patch-added size guard.
Unchecked attacker-controlled EXIF length is forwarded to libexif.
ASan reports a 6-byte heap-buffer-overflow READ in memcmp while libexif checks the EXIF header.

format.name: EXIF metadata blob
format.contract: Candidate input must remain parser-admissible for smartcrop_fuzzer, through vips__exif_parse, while preserving attacker control over type / data / length, so execution reaches vips_exif_load_data_without_fix and the sink in exif_data_load_data.

parser_admitted.description: The PoC is admitted far enough to execute vips__exif_parse on the path toward the annotated source/root-cause/sink chain.
